card.name: Partway through adverse-effect medical terms
card.fires_on: Fires on a middle piece of long medical words for side effects, such as dystonia, lability, hypotension and leukopenia, just before the word ends. Also seen on 'adverse' in 'Grade 3 or 4 adverse reactions'.
